title: NextJS 15: NextAuth 5 (Auth.js) Demo - Basic Credentials
description:
Learn how to implement basic credentials authentication using NextAuth.js v5 (Auth.js) with Next.js 15. This tutorial covers Server Actions, Server Components, page protection, and role-based authorization to secure your app effectively.

Download Starting Project: https://github.com/Pastelmood/NextAuth-Demo/blob/project-starting/snapshot/starting-project.zip
